title: Junior Accountant
lines: Position Details
Department:Operations
Reports To:Team Leader / Client Point-of-Contact
Employment Type:Full-Time (Permanent)
Work Site:Angeles City / San Fernando City
Work Schedule:Monday to Friday Night Shift (09:00PM to 06:00AM)
About the Job

The Junior Accountant provides accounting and administrative support to the client's operations by processing financial transactions, maintaining accurate accounting records, preparing financial documentation, and assisting with day-to-day accounting activities. The role ensures the timely and accurate processing of invoices, owner charges, reimbursements, levy administration, and financial records while maintaining compliance with established client procedures and company standards.

This position is ideal for individuals who are detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to build a career in accounting. Comprehensive training will be provided to equip successful candidates with the knowledge and skills required to support client operations effectively.
Responsibilities
Financial Transaction Processing
Process invoices and financial documents accurately and in a timely manner.
Assist in processing Funds on Behalf (FOB) transactions.
Process owner reimbursements and verify supporting documentation.
Assist in processing lot owner charges and other financial transactions.
Maintain accurate accounting records and financial documentation.
Strata Levy Administration
Prepare and process strata levy transactions within the accounting system.
Generate and distribute levy notices to property owners.
Maintain accurate levy records and supporting documentation.
Administrative Support
Create and update supplier records within the accounting system.
Process work orders and quotation requests.
Generate strata certificates and other finance-related documents.
Perform filing, document management, and electronic record keeping.
Maintain organized financial files, trackers, and operational records.
Data Management
Enter and maintain accurate financial information within company systems.
Review and validate supporting documents before processing transactions.
Assist with record reconciliation and data verification activities.
Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and up to date.
Team Support
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of accounting processes.
Assist with accounting reports and administrative projects as required.
Perform other accounting and administrative duties assigned in support of client operations.
Requirements
Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Management Accounting, Financial Management, or any business-related course.
Fresh graduates are highly encouraged to apply.
Experience
Previous experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, administrative support, or data entry is an advantage but not required.
Internship or on-the-job training in accounting or finance is an advantage.
Fresh graduates with a strong willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
Technical Skills
Basic understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.
Good computer navigation and data entry skills.
Ability to learn accounting software and client-specific systems quickly.
Strong numerical aptitude with excellent attention to detail.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Good written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Professional, dependable, and committed to maintaining confidentiality and integrity when handling financial information.
Benefits
Company events
Health insurance
Life insurance
Opportunities for promotion
Paid training

title: Mid-Level Accountant (Nightshift)
lines: Position Details
Department:Operations
Reports To:Team Leader / Client Point-of-Contact
Employment Type:Full-Time (Permanent)
Work Site:Main Office: Angeles City
Work Schedule:Monday to Friday (09:00PM to 06:00AM)
About the Job

The Mid-Level Accountant manages mid-tier financial operations for strata-titled properties. Positioned between junior and senior roles, this position prepares and reviews financial statements, executes accounts payable and bank reconciliations, drafts property budgets, manages levy operations, and handles end-of-year financial preparations.
Responsibilities
Accounts Payable & Banking Management
Oversee invoice and credit processing, execute payment runs, process lot owner charges/reimbursements, and perform daily bank downloads and reconciliations.
Levy Management & Communication
Strike levies in the system, issue levy notices, handle debt recovery processes, and respond to email/phone inquiries regarding levies from owners and clients.
Budgeting & Financial Tracking
Draft property budgets, log management activities, and reconcile accounts to ensure transparent fund allocation for operations.
Financial Year-End Preparation:
Assist in year-end financial closing, including adjusting charges and interest, reallocating codes and funds, and preparing files for audit compliance.
Requirements
Qualifications:
A. Education
• Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Finance, or related business courses (Open to fresh graduates).
B. Experience
• Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in general accounting, accounts payable, or financial reporting (prior experience in BPO, real estate, or offshore client operations is highly preferred).
C. Technical Skills
• Strong proficiency in end-to-end accounting processes (AP, AR, Bank Reconciliations, GL).
• Intermediate to advanced MS Excel skills (data analysis, formulas, financial formatting).
• Aptitude for navigating specialized strata accounting platforms and ERP tools.
D. Soft Skills
• High analytical skills and strong numerical accuracy.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for handling levy queries.
• Strong time management and problem-solving abilities
Benefits
Company Events
Paid Training
Health Insurance
Life Insurance
Birthday Leave
Opportunities for Career Growth

title: Senior Accountant
lines: Position Details
Department:Operations
Reports To:Team Leader / Client Point-of-Contact
Employment Type:Full-Time (Permanent)
Work Site:Main Office: Angeles City
Work Schedule:Monday to Friday (07:00AM to 04:00PM)
About the Job

The Strata Senior Accountant leads and oversees financial operations for strata properties. This role ensures complete financial compliance, accurate accounting, property budgeting, and financial reporting. Additionally, the Senior Accountant handles high-level tax compliance, leads property setups, coordinates external audits, drives process improvements, and provides mentorship to junior team members.
Responsibilities
I. Financial Reporting & Statements:

Prepare accurate financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements) compliant with strata accounting standards, ensuring timely delivery to property managers and stakeholders.
II. Building Set Up & Tax Compliance:
Manage new building setups, execute GST-BAS lodgments, and oversee full tax compliance across strata portfolios.
III. Audit Coordination:
Facilitate external audits, collaborate with auditors, provide documentation, and resolve audit findings within designated timelines.
IV. Process Improvement & Leadership:
Streamline accounting workflows, establish financial best practices, and provide direct guidance, supervision, and mentorship to junior and mid-level finance staff.
V. Advanced Financial Operations:
Oversee AP management, payment runs, daily bank reconciliations, property budget drafting, levy striking, debt recovery, and complex year-end fund reallocations.
Requirements
A. Education
• Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy or Finance (CPA certification is a major advantage).
B. Experience

• Minimum of 4–5+ years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role handling complex financial reporting and tax compliance (BPO/offshore strata experience highly preferred).
C. Technical Skills
• Advanced knowledge of general ledger, financial reporting standards, GST/BAS, and tax filing processes.
• Expert proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables).
• High proficiency in specialized property management and strata accounting software.
D. Soft Skills
• Exceptional leadership, mentorship, and team collaboration skills.
• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking capabilities.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication for stakeholder engagement and auditor liaising.
Benefits
Company Events
Paid Training
Health Insurance
Life Insurance
Birthday Leave
Opportunities for Career Growth

title: Human Resources Assistant
lines: Position Details
Department:Human Resources Department
Reports To:Human Resources Officer
Employment Type:Full-Time (Permanent)
Work Site:Main Office: Angeles City
Work Schedule:Monday to Friday (07:00AM to 04:00PM)
About the Job
The HR Assistant provides administrative and operational support across various HR functions with a primary focus on assisting with Industrial Relations, HR Compliance, and Employee Relations.

The role will focus on assisting employee relations cases, disciplinary matters, HR documentation, investigations, and compliance. The HR Assistant will also provide support to other areas of HR, including employee engagement, recruitment, onboarding, employee records, attendance and leave administration, performance management, and other HR initiatives as required.
Responsibilities
I. Industrial Relations and Employee Relations Support
Assist in managing and monitoring employee relations and Industrial Relations cases.
Support the preparation and organization of documentation related to employee concerns, policy violations, and disciplinary cases.
Assist in the preparation and processing of Notices to Explain (NTEs), written warnings, disciplinary notices, and other HR correspondence.
Assist in coordinating administrative hearings, employee meetings, and case discussions.
Support the gathering and organization of information and documentation required for investigations.
Maintain accurate and confidential records of employee relations and disciplinary cases.
Monitor the status of ongoing cases and ensure that required follow-ups are completed.
Assist in addressing employee concerns and grievances and escalate matters to the appropriate HR representative when necessary.
Support the consistent implementation of company policies, Employee handbook, and Code of Conduct.
Assist in identifying recurring employee relations concerns and escalating trends to HR management.
II. HR Compliance Support
Assist in maintaining HR compliance records and documentation.
Support the preparation of documents required for internal audits, compliance reviews, and government requirements.
Assist in monitoring HR documents and records to ensure they are complete and updated.
Help maintain organized and confidential employee files and HR records.
Assist in tracking compliance-related activities and deadlines.
Support the HR team in implementing company policies and ensuring proper documentation for HR processes.
III. General HR Administration
Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team
Assist in preparing HR reports, trackers, presentations, and documentation.
Prepare HR-related letters, certificates, notices, and other employee documents.
Assist with filing, documentation, and record management.
Support the HR team in responding to employee inquiries and requests.
Assist in coordinating HR activities, meetings, and employee communications.
Ensure that confidential employee information is handled appropriately and securely.
IV. Recruitment and Onboarding Support
Assist the Recruitment team with administrative and coordination activities as required.
Support employee orientation and onboarding activities when required.
V. Employee Engagement and HR Initiatives
Assist in the planning and coordination of employee engagement activities and HR programs.
Support HR events, employee activities, surveys, and internal communications.
Assist in gathering employee feedback and preparing reports or summaries.
Support HR initiatives related to employee experience, culture, and retention.
Participate in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
VI. Other HR Support
Provide administrative and operational assistance to other HR team members as required.
Provide backup support to other HR functions during periods of high workload or staff absence.
Assist with special HR projects and initiatives as assigned.
Perform other HR-related duties and responsibilities that may reasonably be assigned by the HR Manager or People & Culture Head.
Requirements
A. Education
Bachelor’s degree in Psychology
B. Experience
0-1 year experience in Human Resources particularly in Industrial Relations
C. Technical Skills

Industrial & Employee Relations Documentation: Knowledge of labor standards, due process, and hands-on experience drafting Notices to Explain (NTEs), written warnings, disciplinary notices, and administrative hearing minutes.

HR Compliance & Records Management: Proficiency in maintaining confidential physical and digital employee files, tracking compliance deadlines, and preparing documentation for internal audits and government requirements.

HR Information Systems (HRIS) & Tracking: Familiarity with HR database software, attendance/leave tracking tools, and proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for compiling HR reports, trackers, and presentations.
General HR Operations: Ability to coordinate recruitment workflows, conduct onboarding orientations, and assist with employee engagement activities and feedback collection.
D. Soft Skills
Discretion & Confidentiality: Absolute integrity and tact when handling highly sensitive personnel records, investigation details, and disciplinary proceedings.
Active Listening & Conflict Resolution: High emotional intelligence to handle employee grievances, concerns, and sensitive discussions with empathy and impartiality.

Exceptional Written & Verbal Communication: Clear, professional, and precise communication skills for drafting legalistic HR notices, policy communications, and liaising across all levels of the organization.
Keen Attention to Detail: High accuracy in legal/HR documentation, case monitoring, record-keeping, and tracking case timelines.
Organizational & Time Management Skills: Ability to prioritize multi-faceted tasks across employee relations, recruitment support, and administrative deadlines efficiently.
